admin.host_help: The Manticore server's host name or IP, reachable from your forum's server. Nothing is sent anywhere until this is filled in.
admin.table_prefix_help: Optional. Keeps tables apart when several forums share one Manticore server. Leave blank to use your forum's host name.
admin.auth_help: Optional. Only if your Manticore sits behind a proxy that asks for HTTP basic authentication. The password is stored on the server and never sent to visitors.
admin.drivers_help: Text searches go to Manticore; filtering and browsing keep using the database. Flarum still decides what each visitor may see. If Manticore cannot be reached, search quietly falls back to the database.
admin.not_configured: Enter a host and save first.
admin.rebuild_help: Builds the discussions, posts and users tables from your existing content. Run it once after connecting, and whenever you think the index has drifted. On a large forum, run a queue worker so this happens in the background.
admin.rebuild_failed: Could not start the rebuild. Check the connection settings.
